name: Port the game manifest, EngineState and the render backends, HeadlessRenderer included

comments.text: Part 2a: engine/src/host/EngineState.nox (EngineState, InputState with the engine's F5/F1 actions, EntityTags, ParseColor) and RenderBackend.nox (the RenderBackend interface, RenderReport and HeadlessRenderer); src/runner/GpuRenderBackend.nox wraps GpuRenderer, outside src/host so host tests don't need a GPU. Tested by tests/host/the-engine-state-resets-what-a-session-made. The game manifest comes with ScriptSession.
Part 2c adds GameManifest and ScriptSource (engine/src/host/GameManifest.nox). EngineState and the render backends were done in part 2a.
